root_cause: When an item is removed from the basket, the focused element (the remove button) is deleted from the DOM. The focus trap's internal list of tabbable nodes becomes stale, so when focus escapes to the body, the trap cannot accurately restore focus to an element within the basket.
repair_strategy: After removing an item, call the focus trap's `updateContainerElements` method to refresh its tabbable nodes, ensuring the trap has an accurate set of focusable nodes to restore focus to.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus will remain trapped inside the basket dialog after removing an item, allowing users to continue navigating with the Tab key.
functional_risks: Updating the trap's container elements may cause a brief performance impact, but it is negligible for this small DOM.
verification_requirements: After removing an item, pressing Tab should move focus to the next focusable element within the basket dialog, and the basket dialog should retain focus.
